title: Ukraine saw a 57.3% y/y fall in steel production in August
content:
In August 2026, Ukraine’s steelworks reduced their steel output by 57.3% year-on-year, to 277,000 tonnes. This is according to data from the state-owned enterprise Ukrmetallurgprom. Compared with July, the figure fell by 39.4%. Pig iron production in August stood at 257.1 thousand tonnes, which is 65.6% lower year-on-year and 40.5% lower than the previous month.  […]

Fortera's ReCarb technology will capture CO₂ emissions from MLC's production of high-calcium lime, converting the CO₂ directly into cement.
